correctness.rationale: For C_{m,n}=disjoint m copies K_n and its complement D_{m,n}, every automorphism preserves class adjacency in both so automorphism groups and all injective tuple orbits coincide (partitions of k positions into ≤m blocks size≤n). A homomorphism from a loopless source clique K_n injects into one target clique: when n finite its image is exactly n vertices, and with m infinite possible finite ranks are positive multiples of n; when n infinite all ranks infinite. For D, distinct source parts must map into disjoint sets of target parts. If m finite,n infinite, each uses exactly one target part, so finite ranks are every integer ≥m; if m infinite, all ranks infinite. C is homomorphically equivalent to K_n, D to K_m, so uniqueness of countably categorical model-complete core yields respective cores, including ℵ0 and finite edge cases. Finite exhaustive checks of small m,n confirm image-rank mechanisms but infinite proof is structural.
